lines: @Bram Not the grass! Not the grass.

say: @Bram So that’s Emberwall up there? The black bit?
@Cael The Marches. Over the pass.
@Cael There’s a forge on this road older than Cindrel. Before the Marches, one more lesson.

do.hint: Hold Fire on the forge’s heart: it heats while you hold, cools when you stop. Keep it in the gold band until it catches. Too much, and the stone cracks.

say: @Cael The Oruun forged here. It’s been cold a thousand years.
@Cael Fire you throw is easy. Fire you keep is the hard kind.
@Cael Light it. Then hold it there. Not more. Never more.
steps.objective: Light the forge and hold its heat steady

say: @Cael Too much. Feel it go past what it needs. Let it cool, then again, gentler.
@Bram Is it supposed to make that noise?
@Cael There. Now don’t want more for it.
@Bram Maybe less fire? I’m not an expert. In fire.
@Bram The door! The door’s opening!
@Cael It holds. The crack will too. That’s what fire does when you want too much from it.
@Bram The door! The door’s opening!
@Cael Not a mark on it. That’s restraint. It’s rarer than power, and it lasts longer.
@Bram I’ll take first watch. I won’t. But I’ll say I will.
@Cael You held it. You wanted to give it more, and you didn’t.
@Cael You could become something incredible.

choices.label: A hero?
say: @Cael Something more important than that.
@you What’s more important than being a hero?
@Cael Knowing when not to be one.

choices.label: I just want to help people.
say: @Cael I know. That’s the part that worries me.
@Cael Helping is a fire too. It wants more than it needs.

choices.label: (Say nothing.)
say: @Cael Good. Sometimes that’s the answer.
@you The chisel marks. You know whose they are.
@Cael I think I do. I hope I’m wrong.
@Cael Two stones. If there’s a third in the Marches, I won’t be able to hope anymore.
@Cael Morning. The Marches are through the door.
steps.objective: Take the pass north to the Emberwall Marches

say: Cindrel’s furnaces never go out. The Forge-Queen likes it that way.
Stay close in the Marches. Fire listens to you now. So will people who fear it.
Hold it. Don’t feed it more than it needs.
I slept. Don’t tell Cael I slept.
My dad would’ve wept at that forge. Good weeping.
It’s warm up here. Is it always this warm up here?
